text: Frozen an independent cross-iteration intensity audit before any new checkpoint scoring: benchmarks/halfflow/diagnostics/audit-contract-v1.json binds fixed_audit.py and four passing analytic tests. It uses every voxel of a fixed target-brain mask on the original prepared lattice, a fixed 3 mm box window, and target-only variance stabilization. Invalid windows receive maximum squared-CC loss 1 and signed correlation -1; no moving-dependent exclusion or denominator shrinkage is permitted. Reports include fixed counts, center/window coverage, nonfinite counts and exact identities in both directions. This score is diagnostic and absent from optimization/stopping; anatomical labels remain separate. Tests cover identical textured images, coverage loss, nonfinite warped values and undefined flat targets. Actual checkpoint maps have not yet been scored; the Scala observation/writer code remains uncompiled pending completion of the timing study.
